entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I've sympathized with the reform m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've sympathized with the reform movement in the past. In fact, I myself voted for the RPP in the last two elections!"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""But the change they are asking for..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the change they are asking for should happen in dialogue with the Crown and the nobility. It can't simply be forced."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""But I did not return from three de..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I did not return from three decades of exile just to watch my beloved homeland turn into a circus of upheaval yet again."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I agree it's gotten out of hand. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree it's gotten out of hand. But with Mr. Sotelato no longer leading the movement, I have a chance to turn down the temperature."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I had hoped to prevent the situati..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had hoped to prevent the situation from escalating. But Mr. Sotelato and his Malenyevist backers were too powerful."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The movement isn't as radical as y..."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "I only hope it's not too late."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""It's too late for that, my dear. O..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's too late for that, my dear. Or have you been ignoring what's taking place outside these very windows?"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""They do seem to have calmed down i..."
entries.dialogueText: "They do seem to have calmed down in the last months. I hope it will stay that way."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Malenyevist or not, it makes no di..."
entries.dialogueText: "Malenyevist or not, it makes no difference."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""The monsters have been uncaged, an..."
entries.dialogueText: "The monsters have been uncaged, and they're out for blood yet again."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I only hope it's not too late to r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only hope it's not too late to rein them in."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""You should hear what they're shout..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should hear what they're shouting about us at Iza University. It's almost as bad as when your cousin was in charge."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""None of us even dare to set foot i..."
entries.dialogueText: "None of us even dare to set foot in Iza anymore. The city's a separatist republic in all but name."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""We don't want to resort to mass ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't want to resort to mass arrests like in Iza, but nor do we want the Brenas leadership to be steamrolled."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's why I'm talking to you righ..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's why I'm talking to you right now. We can't stop the next uprising without House Sazon's assistance."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Judging by the crowds gathered her..."
entries.dialogueText: "Judging by the crowds gathered here tonight, Rizia may be at a tipping point."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The capital seems free of chaos, a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The capital seems free of chaos, at least. I hope it will stay that way."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Especially now that the chaos has..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially now that the chaos has reached a boiling point."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The crowds outside don't seem like..."
entries.dialogueText: "The crowds outside don't seem like they're calling for slight reforms."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""But with Manus gone, it's turned u..."
entries.dialogueText: "But with Manus gone, it's turned ugly. House Sazon cannot condone what's been happening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I share your concerns, but I don't..."
entries.dialogueText: "I share your concerns, but I don't see what it is you want me to do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Brenas and House Sazon started thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Brenas and House Sazon started this mess. You must clean it up."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""It is too late for anything but th..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is too late for anything but the most dramatic of actions."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He writes from the front now and a..."
entries.dialogueText: "He writes from the front now and again."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""At first he was outraged that you..."
entries.dialogueText: "At first he was outraged that you shut down the House of Delegates. But he's come to see it as a necessary move."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He's strongly against what Adarfo..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's strongly against what Adarfo Sotelato did with the RPP. In fact, he no longer seems interested in reform at all."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He writes from Kyrute now and agai..."
entries.dialogueText: "He writes from Kyrute now and again."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He was outraged at the closure of..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was outraged at the closure of the House of Delegates, but is worried about what the RPP has turned into now that it's gone underground."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He still believes in the need for..."
entries.dialogueText: "He still believes in the need for reform, but he's strongly against what Adarfo Sotelato has done with his party."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I'm worried that a peaceful resolu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm worried that a peaceful resolution to all this is no longer possible."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I trust the Crown not to capitulat..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust the Crown not to capitulate."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""We cannot let ourselves become com..."
entries.dialogueText: "We cannot let ourselves become complacent. As long as the movement exists, there is the threat of an uprising."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""It does seem calm here in the capi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It does seem calm here in the capital. Perhaps there's no need for dramatic action."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your trust will be rewarded, Angel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your trust will be rewarded, Angelica. I must say, I never expected you to be such a loyal ally."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I had to redeem myself somehow, di..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had to redeem myself somehow, didn't I, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I wasn't even 20 when I married Lu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wasn't even 20 when I married Lucas. We started sneaking into underground meetings together, drawing up plots to liberate Rizia from the tyranny of the Crown. It was all so thrilling... romantic, even."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""But when he started planning your..."
entries.dialogueText: "But when he started planning your abduction, I realized he was willing to put his fantasies of revolution before the safety of his own family."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She sighed."
entries.dialogueText: She sighed.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""That isn't brave or noble. It's se..."
entries.dialogueText: "That isn't brave or noble. It's selfish."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at Manus."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at Manus.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Something I hope you'll keep in mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Something I hope you'll keep in mind when you have a family of your own."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Something my own son has yet to un..."
entries.dialogueText: "Something my own son has yet to understand."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You really have changed since the..."
entries.dialogueText: "You really have changed since the 1920s, haven't you, Angelica?"

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I didn't change. I grew up.""
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't change. I grew up."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona gave a nod of understanding."
entries.dialogueText: Leona gave a nod of understanding.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""There's nothing brave or noble abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's nothing brave or noble about the mob outside. They're a group of selfish people, doing this for their own selfish reasons."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yet another reason why the Sazons..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet another reason why the Sazons must join with the Crown and the other royal houses to destroy them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't you think that ending the un..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you think that ending the unrest and bringing peace back to Rizia is of paramount importance, even if it means compromising with the rioters?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona nodded slowly."
entries.dialogueText: Leona nodded slowly.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Don't be naive. These people would..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be naive. These people would murder us all if given half the chance."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""But only if they truly are willing..."
entries.dialogueText: "But only if they truly are willing to compromise."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""They are. I know it.""
entries.dialogueText: "They are. I know it."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I know Lucas would have.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know Lucas would have."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She folded her arms and was silent."
entries.dialogueText: She folded her arms and was silent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw a spark in Angelica's eyes."
entries.dialogueText: I saw a spark in Angelica's eyes.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""This was why you brought me back,..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was why you brought me back, wasn't it? You knew the others would be too weak to rally House Sazon to your side."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Weak? Angelica, I must object.""
entries.dialogueText: "Weak? Angelica, I must object."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Selfishness is clinging to wealth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Selfishness is clinging to wealth and power at the expense of the less fortunate. It's what nobles like us have been doing for centuries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree that Lucas Sazon should ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree that Lucas Sazon should never have acted as rashly as he did. That doesn't mean his ideals weren't worth believing in."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""The Sazons have given far more wea..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Sazons have given far more wealth to Rizia than we've taken. Where do those ungrateful students in Iza think their university buildings come from?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't you think it would save us a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you think it would save us a great deal of grief to compromise with the reformists, rather than live in constant fear of another uprising?"

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Don't be naive. I had contact with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be naive. I had contact with their circles in the 1920s. These people don't do things by half measures."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""It would. But only if they are tru..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would. But only if they are truly willing to compromise."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""They are. I know it.""
entries.dialogueText: "They are. I know it."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I know Lucas didn't.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know Lucas didn't."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She folded her arms and was silent."
entries.dialogueText: She folded her arms and was silent.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""It's not my intention to stand in..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not my intention to stand in the way of progress. If it comes down to it, I will support reforms."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Especially if Manus is the one beh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially if Manus is the one behind them."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Though it would be easier if Manus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though it would be easier if Manus was the one behind them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Some of them have families as well..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some of them have families as well. They're trying to give them a better future."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""And they think they can do that by..."
entries.dialogueText: "And they think they can do that by reducing their homeland to ruins?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's selfish is to refuse to com..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's selfish is to refuse to compromise with them, even when doing so could save lives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know you still harbor anger towa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you still harbor anger towards Lucas. But not all revolutionaries are like him."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""From what I've seen and heard, mos..."
entries.dialogueText: "From what I've seen and heard, most are worse."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I have walked among these circles,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have walked among these circles, Your Majesty. Compromise is not a language they speak."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""His ideals of destroying the monar..."
entries.dialogueText: "His ideals of destroying the monarchy? Your Majesty, I hesitate to think what you're implying right now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Manus isn't anything like his fath..."
entries.dialogueText: "Manus isn't anything like his father. He believes in improving the system we have, not tearing it down."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am glad you've come to understan..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am glad you've come to understand the error of your former ways. You are a credit to your house."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Both of us want to keep Father's m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both of us want to keep Father's mistakes from being repeated, Mother. The longer we keep the status quo, the greater the chances another Lucas Sazon will arise. Or worse."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus swiveled his head to look aro..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus swiveled his head to look around the room.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Much appreciated, my cousin. But p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Much appreciated, my cousin. But please don't say a word about this until the time is right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They aren't monsters. They can be..."
entries.dialogueText: "They aren't monsters. They can be reasoned with."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""You don't know them like I do.""
entries.dialogueText: "You don't know them like I do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's change the subject. Such top..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's change the subject. Such topics are unpleasant to discuss on the Queen Mother's birthday."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will end the unrest and bring pe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will end the unrest and bring peace to the kingdom. Just trust me on this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona nodded eagerly."
entries.dialogueText: Leona nodded eagerly.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I agree. Leave the politics talk t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. Leave the politics talk to another time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona and Angelica exchanged uneasy..."
entries.dialogueText: Leona and Angelica exchanged uneasy looks.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""We do.""
entries.dialogueText: "We do."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona gave me an uneasy look."
entries.dialogueText: Leona gave me an uneasy look.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I do.""
entries.dialogueText: "I do."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus drew in his breath."
entries.dialogueText: Manus drew in his breath.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw uncertainty in Leona's eyes."
entries.dialogueText: I saw uncertainty in Leona's eyes.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Who was the one holding Brenas tog..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who was the one holding Brenas together while you and Manus were away? Don't I deserve the slightest bit of credit?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus wasn't listening to either of..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus wasn't listening to either of them. He turned towards me.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty, is it really your pl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, is it really your plan to use the nobility to stomp out dissent? Because if it is, I have serious objections."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Does Vina know? She'd never agree..."
entries.dialogueText: "Does Vina know? She'd never agree to such a thing--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona politely but firmly cut him o..."
entries.dialogueText: Leona politely but firmly cut him off.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""This isn't your decision to make,..."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't your decision to make, Manus. It's your mother's."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I was the one holding our house to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was the one holding our house together while you and Angelica were in exile. This isn't your decision to make."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus gave a conflicted sigh."
entries.dialogueText: Manus gave a conflicted sigh.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""You may stand with House Sazon, or..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may stand with House Sazon, or get out of our way."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I am with you, Your Majesty, but t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am with you, Your Majesty, but there is a limit to what House Sazon can do."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Manus could have inspired the fami..."
entries.dialogueText: "Manus could have inspired the families of Brenas to take action, but without him..."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Need I remind you that our heir --..."
entries.dialogueText: "Need I remind you that our heir -- and our most persuasive member -- is a reformist himself?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The uncertainty began to give way t..."
entries.dialogueText: The uncertainty began to give way to resolve.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The only way we'll stand a chance,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only way we'll stand a chance, Your Majesty, is if you bring back the head of our house."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Angelica. End her exile, and she w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Angelica. End her exile, and she will rally House Sazon to your side."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I wish the same, my cousin. But th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish the same, my cousin. But the rest of my party has spoken."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your support is much appreciated...."
entries.dialogueText: "Your support is much appreciated. But please don't say a word about this until the time is right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will hold you to your word, Leon..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will hold you to your word, Leona. I promise Brenas will be better off in the end."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's change the subject, shall we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's change the subject, shall we? Wouldn't want the other nobles in the room getting wind of this conversation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I count on your discretion going f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I count on your discretion going forward. We will act on this very soon."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""No, indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, indeed."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""And I will hold you to that promis..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I will hold you to that promise, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I won't tell a soul, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I won't tell a soul, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The reform movement is the least p..."
entries.dialogueText: "The reform movement is the least pressing issue facing Rizia today. Let's not dwell on it."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""No, indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, indeed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica took her cousin's hand."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica took her cousin's hand.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""You have done a fine job, Leona. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have done a fine job, Leona. But alone, you don't have what it takes to quell an uprising. I am only stating the facts."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both women turned towards me."
entries.dialogueText: Both women turned towards me.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""We and Brenas are with you. We wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "We and Brenas are with you. We will end this nonsense and restore dignity to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""House Sazon is with you, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Sazon is with you, Your Majesty. But you must remember that we still lack authority after the events of the last half-century..."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""If you were to reconsider your dec..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you were to reconsider your decision to centralize the Zille region, we could amass the strength necessary to defeat the revolution."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""The trust you've displayed in Hous..."
entries.dialogueText: "The trust you've displayed in House Sazon over the past few years has been nothing less than miraculous, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Granting my pardon, bringing Zille..."
entries.dialogueText: "Granting my pardon, bringing Zille back to us..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The traitor? Never. She will die o..."
entries.dialogueText: "The traitor? Never. She will die on Caleqabiz."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will do whatever it takes to win..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will do whatever it takes to win this. Tell your cousin that her banishment is over."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How can you guarantee that she wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "How can you guarantee that she will do as I ask? That she doesn't still resent the Crown for punishing her?"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""We have spoken many times, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have spoken many times, Your Majesty. Set her free, and I guarantee she will be a loyal ally."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's been over 30 years. Does Bren..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's been over 30 years. Does Brenas even remember her?"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Even from exile, she commands the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even from exile, she commands the hearts of our province."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Do you mean that?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you mean that?"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""She is no traitor, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "She is no traitor, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Remember, she was the one who hand..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember, she was the one who handed in Lucas Sazon to your father. Her own husband!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She was saving her own skin. That..."
entries.dialogueText: "She was saving her own skin. That hardly counts as loyalty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It does take courage to commit suc..."
entries.dialogueText: "It does take courage to commit such an act. Especially as a young woman."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All that says to me is that she is..."
entries.dialogueText: "All that says to me is that she is capable of lying and treachery, even against those she loves."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Countess put a hand to her hear..."
entries.dialogueText: The Countess put a hand to her heart in astonishment.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""First Zille, now this... the rift..."
entries.dialogueText: "First Zille, now this... the rift between our houses truly has begun to heal."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The rift between our houses truly..."
entries.dialogueText: "The rift between our houses truly has begun to heal."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""And when Manus returns home from t..."
entries.dialogueText: "And when Manus returns home from the war, we will be fully whole."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The heir to House Sazon, one of Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "The heir to House Sazon, one of Rizia's proudest of noble families."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Manus, don't forget that you and V..."
entries.dialogueText: "Manus, don't forget that you and Vina are set to inherit the throne. Defeat the revolution, and the two of you can steer Rizia in whatever direction you want."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The time for toying around with de..."
entries.dialogueText: "The time for toying around with democratic ideals is over. Now man up and claim your birthright."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's your fault this movement has..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's your fault this movement has grown as large as it has. By order of the King, you will help fix this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You still care for Vina, don't you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You still care for Vina, don't you? The revolutionaries will never let her live."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Forget it, madam. Manus doesn't ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forget it, madam. Manus doesn't have the spine to defend his house or his king."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""She's right, son. You will stand w..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's right, son. You will stand with House Sazon, or you'll get out of the way."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The Palesians may kill her anyway,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Palesians may kill her anyway, thanks to her father placing her in harm's way."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Her Highness is already out of har..."
entries.dialogueText: "Her Highness is already out of harm's way. Out of this cage of a country."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Her Highness should decide for her..."
entries.dialogueText: "Her Highness should decide for herself whether Rizia is to be defended in such a manner."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Are you sure about that, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure about that, Your Majesty? Another heir is coming, after all."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Can you guarantee me that Her High..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can you guarantee me that Her Highness will still be first in line for the throne, no matter the sex of your child-to-be?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus swallowed hard."
entries.dialogueText: Manus swallowed hard.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""If you will not do anything to jeo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you will not do anything to jeopardize that inheritance... then I suppose I have no choice."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Whatever it is you're planning, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever it is you're planning, I want no part in it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, I can't guarantee that. I prom..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I can't guarantee that. I promised House Azaro that if the child is male, he will be my successor. But there's only a 50 percent chance that will happen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I cannot. If Vina's younger siblin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot. If Vina's younger sibling is a boy, he will be my successor. Those are the rules."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I am with you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am with you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He glared at me in obvious offense."
entries.dialogueText: He glared at me in obvious offense.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""What kind of a man do you think I..."
entries.dialogueText: "What kind of a man do you think I am, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Crown Prince Consort and a mem..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Crown Prince Consort and a member of the Royal Family. Defending the Crown is part of that package."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""A very good question. I share my s..."
entries.dialogueText: "A very good question. I share my son's curiosity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. You have my word that no matt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. You have my word that no matter what happens, you will remain the Crown Prince Consort of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why is everyone so fixated on my u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why is everyone so fixated on my unborn child's genitals? Frankly, it's disgusting."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I too find it peculiar that such a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I too find it peculiar that such a minor feature should dictate one's inheritance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The sex of Lucita's child makes no..."
entries.dialogueText: "The sex of Lucita's child makes no difference. Vina is my firstborn. She deserves the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Minor? Speak for yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Minor? Speak for yourself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rules are meant to be broken. I wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rules are meant to be broken. I will make sure that as my firstborn, Vina succeeds me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Regardless, tradition is tradition..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regardless, tradition is tradition. If the child is a boy, I will have no choice but to make him my successor."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Then I am sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then I am sorry."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus took a step backwards."
entries.dialogueText: Manus took a step backwards.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Then... I am with you, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then... I am with you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""As is all of House Sazon.""
entries.dialogueText: "As is all of House Sazon."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Please, Your Majesty. You know per..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty. You know perfectly well what I mean."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Just answer his question, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just answer his question, Your Majesty. Can you promise that Her Highness Princess Vina will succeed you?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""A Rizia under Azaro rule will hard..."
entries.dialogueText: "A Rizia under Azaro rule will hardly be better off than one under the revolutionaries."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He scowled and walked off to join V..."
entries.dialogueText: He scowled and walked off to join Vina.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He scowled and walked off to talk t..."
entries.dialogueText: He scowled and walked off to talk to other guests.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus swallowed hard."
entries.dialogueText: Manus swallowed hard.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I suppose I knew I would have to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose I knew I would have to make a choice like this after marrying Vina."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Am I still the Crown Prince Consor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Am I still the Crown Prince Consort? Another heir is coming, after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A man who does as his King command..."
entries.dialogueText: "A man who does as his King commands."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I'm sorry. I'm not going to stand..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry. I'm not going to stand around and listen to this talk."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Until you have taken up arms to pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Until you have taken up arms to protect your kingdom, you are no man at all."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty, if you had only list..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, if you had only listened to me years ago, none of this would be happening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Leona? Angelica? Are you still wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Leona? Angelica? Are you still with me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Leona? Are you still with me?""
entries.dialogueText: "Leona? Are you still with me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We don't need him, anyway. Right,..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't need him, anyway. Right, ladies?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It will be difficult to do this wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will be difficult to do this without Manus, but I know the rest of House Sazon has the strength to aid me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We don't need him anyway. Am I rig..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't need him anyway. Am I right?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It will be difficult to do this wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will be difficult to do this without Manus, but I know the rest of House Sazon has the strength to aid me."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""If we had reclaimed our ancestral..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we had reclaimed our ancestral lands in Zille, perhaps we could amass the strength necessary to defeat the revolution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Zille has yet to recover from the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille has yet to recover from the effects of the Wehlen occupation. You want to destabilize it further?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You think the people of Zille will..."
entries.dialogueText: "You think the people of Zille will help? They're hardly even Rizians."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. Stand with us against t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Stand with us against the revolutionaries, and I will gladly return Zille into your house's hands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see. You never forgave my family..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. You never forgave my family for taking Zille away from you."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""We would not be destabilizing the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We would not be destabilizing the province. We would be uniting it under its former banner."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Leona nodded.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Among those who remember life unde..."
entries.dialogueText: "Among those who remember life under Rizian rule, loyalty to House Sazon has not faded."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not forget that it was I, Romus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not forget that it was I, Romus Toras, who stopped the recent unrest in its tracks. I expect nothing but gratitude from your house."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""And you have it, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "And you have it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nobody would dare go against the w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody would dare go against the will of God's messenger on Earth."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""No, indeed...""
entries.dialogueText: "No, indeed..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am less troubled by the commoner..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am less troubled by the commoners' protests than I am by the specter of dissent within the nobility."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not forget that it is I, Romus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not forget that it is I, Romus Toras, who keeps this kingdom safe from unrest. I expect nothing but gratitude from your house."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Such a prospect horrifies us as we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such a prospect horrifies us as well, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""She was risking her own life. She..."
entries.dialogueText: "She was risking her own life. She didn't know what punishment awaited her."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""She did it for the sake of her chi..."
entries.dialogueText: "She did it for the sake of her child. And for the sake of her kingdom."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""She realized that a movement that..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not take your freedom for grant..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not take your freedom for granted, even for a second. Remember that you are only here by my mercy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're so polite. Nothing at all l..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're so polite. Nothing at all like certain junior members of House Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you hear anything from Manus th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you hear anything from Manus these days?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her expression soured."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
