entries.dialogueText: "I am so sorry that Manus couldn't be here today. He sends his best regards."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A muscle in her jaw twitched."
entries.dialogueText: A muscle in her jaw twitched.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Yes. Your Majesty. You have my eve..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Your Majesty. You have my everlasting gratitude."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""He's right, Mother. We want you to..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's right, Mother. We want you to feel at home in Porte Drazon."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""House Sazon will always back the C..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Sazon will always back the Crown. Even if our province is longer represented in government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know exactly why he isn't here...."
entries.dialogueText: "I know exactly why he isn't here. And it speaks to your loyalty that you came without him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My regards to him as well. I hope..."
entries.dialogueText: "My regards to him as well. I hope he is enjoying his retirement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""His duty as a Delegate is over. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "His duty as a Delegate is over. It's time for him to claim his birthright as heir to House Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just as well. I don't want to see..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just as well. I don't want to see his face, either."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""My cousin attached a lot of import..."
entries.dialogueText: "My cousin attached a lot of importance to his role in the House of Delegates, Your Majesty. It has not been easy for him to let it go."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""And he is not the only one. A grea..."
entries.dialogueText: "And he is not the only one. A great many Brenas councilors are quite irate that the province is no longer represented in government."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""And I must confess, he is not the..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I must confess, he is not the only one concerned by Rizia's new religious direction."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""But I must confess, he is not the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I must confess, he is not the only one concerned by Rizia's new religious direction."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Though a great many councilors fro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though a great many councilors from Brenas were also distraught by the House of Delegates' dissolution."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Quite understandable. To think he'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quite understandable. To think he'd let his political views get in the way of honoring the Queen Mother..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Vina and I will be here for quite..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina and I will be here for quite some time, you know."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled warily."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled warily.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled warmly."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled warmly.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Yes, I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I know."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Please, Your Majesty. It pains me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty. It pains me to think of my son's wasted potential."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I had known you were so charmin..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I had known you were so charming, I would have ended your exile long ago."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I am only expressing my gratitude..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am only expressing my gratitude to my king. As every subject of the Rizian crown ought to."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave a half-smile."
entries.dialogueText: She gave a half-smile.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And? What did you think of the por..."
entries.dialogueText: "And? What did you think of the portrait?"

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""The skill of the artist was very e..."
entries.dialogueText: "The skill of the artist was very evident. He or she should be commended."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Well, I thought it was absolutely..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I thought it was absolutely beautiful. Age should be something to be celebrated, not concealed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am always open to hearing the co..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am always open to hearing the concerns of my people. Tell the former Delegates they may reach out to me at any time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Should I bring the Golden Guard ov..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should I bring the Golden Guard over here and have you repeat that complaint to them?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She paled."
entries.dialogueText: She paled.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""No need, Your Majesty. Forgive me.""
entries.dialogueText: "No need, Your Majesty. Forgive me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She paled. Angelica put a hand on h..."
entries.dialogueText: She paled. Angelica put a hand on her shoulder.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""No need, Your Majesty. Forgive her.""
entries.dialogueText: "No need, Your Majesty. Forgive her."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled in relief."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled in relief.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""They'll be happy to hear it. Thank..."
entries.dialogueText: "They'll be happy to hear it. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica put a hand on her shoulder..."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica put a hand on her shoulder.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""No need, Your Majesty. I'll calm t..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need, Your Majesty. I'll calm them down myself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They hardly accomplished anything..."
entries.dialogueText: "They hardly accomplished anything as Delegates. They should be working toward on-the-ground change in their province instead of hanging around Porte Drazon."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Yes... I'll relay that to them.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... I'll relay that to them."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""They're whining over nothing, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're whining over nothing, Your Majesty. I will calm them down."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell them I am perfectly capable o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell them I am perfectly capable of governing my kingdom without their interference -- I mean, input."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I gave ZIlle back to Brenas, didn'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I gave ZIlle back to Brenas, didn't I? What do they have to complain about?"

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Quite right, Your Majesty. I'll re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quite right, Your Majesty. I'll remind them of your generosity."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""You did. They should be more grate..."
entries.dialogueText: "You did. They should be more grateful, it's true."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""They know that already, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "They know that already, Your Majesty. We all do."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I had my doubts as well, Leona.""
entries.dialogueText: "I had my doubts as well, Leona."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""The Dastnurists of Brenas will be..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Dastnurists of Brenas will be fine, Leona. Consider this a measure to bring Rizia what it needs most: unity."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I could never force such a decisio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I could never force such a decision upon someone..."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""But I will try to persuade my prov..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I will try to persuade my province of the necessity of these new measures."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Yes... you are both right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... you are both right."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But as Crown Prince Consort, I see..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as Crown Prince Consort, I see it as my duty to ease Rizia through its transition to a theocracy."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""With the assumption that we will h..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the assumption that we will hold fast to the Wruhecist values of tolerance, charity, and curiosity."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He writes from the front now and a..."
entries.dialogueText: "He writes from the front now and again."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""At first he was outraged that you..."
entries.dialogueText: "At first he was outraged that you shut down the House of Delegates. But he has come to see it as a necessary move."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He writes from Kyrute now and agai..."
entries.dialogueText: "He writes from Kyrute now and again."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He's worried about the direction t..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's worried about the direction the RPP has taken in his absence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Manus Sazon was a true patriot who..."
entries.dialogueText: "Manus Sazon was a true patriot who fought and died for this kingdom. You have my condolences on his loss."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""It means a lot to hear you say tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "It means a lot to hear you say that. My son's so-called colleagues never even reached out to House Sazon after the funeral."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""It means a lot to hear you say tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "It means a lot to hear you say that. Manus' so-called colleagues never even reached out to House Sazon after the funeral."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Most recently after the business w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Most recently after the business with Adarfo Sotelato. He was shocked by the assassination, but I suspect he was relieved as well."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Most recently after the business w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Most recently after the business with Adarfo Sotelato. He seemed upset that the Crown imprisoned him, but I suspect he was secretly relieved."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He has a great many Arcasian conta..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has a great many Arcasian contacts over there now. They have reason to believe none other than United Contana was behind Sotelato's rise to power."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I wish this war had never been thr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish this war had never been thrust upon us, Your Majesty. But if there's a silver lining, it's that my son has learned the true meaning of responsibility to his kingdom."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The war has changed his outlook gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The war has changed his outlook greatly, Your Majesty. It's caused him to question his prior notions of reforming the country."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""My son is becoming a citizen of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "My son is becoming a citizen of the world. He's finally realizing that the monarchy serves to keep Rizia insulated from far worse threats."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Manus and the Sazon troops have fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Manus and the Sazon troops have fought admirably. When we defeat Pales, he will get a hero's welcome."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He still hopes that the Rizian mon..."
entries.dialogueText: "He still hopes that the Rizian monarchy will be reformed one day. But he acknowledges that there are far worse threats out there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have my condolences on Manus'..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have my condolences on Manus' death. He was both a hero and a patriot."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm disappointed that he's given u..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm disappointed that he's given up on his ideals. Fighting for one's county means fighting for your right to change it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He grew up in exile and was educat..."
entries.dialogueText: "He grew up in exile and was educated abroad. He never knew what it meant to be Rizian until now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew that fighting for his kingd..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew that fighting for his kingdom would make a man out of him. Just like it did to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Would those Arcasian contacts happ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Would those Arcasian contacts happen to have any inside information about Sotelato's assassination?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: Leona shook her head.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""They claim the Walker administrati..."
entries.dialogueText: "They claim the Walker administration had nothing to do with it. Of course, who knows if they're telling the truth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm glad to hear it. But I still d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad to hear it. But I still don't want Manus showing his face in Rizia again."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He has no intention of returning,..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has no intention of returning, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Arcasians are no better. We're..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Arcasians are no better. We're losing good men and women in Pales thanks to ATO's interference."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Try as they might, the CSP will ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Try as they might, the CSP will never get their hooks into us."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""We know Lespia is involved in Pale..."
entries.dialogueText: "We know Lespia is involved in Pales. But President Walker is trying to keep his hands clean."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Typical Arcasian propaganda-monger..."
entries.dialogueText: "Typical Arcasian propaganda-mongering. Anyone fighting for the welfare of the common man has got to be a Malenyevist plant."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Heaven forbid.""
entries.dialogueText: "Heaven forbid."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He went to that conference in Galm..."
entries.dialogueText: "He went to that conference in Galmland, didn't he? I'm sure his web of CSP connections extends far and wide."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""The events of '26 left me skeptica..."
entries.dialogueText: "The events of '26 left me skeptical of Arcasia's motives. But in this case, they do seem to be the lesser of the two evils."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I can't wait until that day comes,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't wait until that day comes, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He may yet regain that fighting sp..."
entries.dialogueText: "He may yet regain that fighting spirit when he returns. If he returns."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I only hope he has many more years..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only hope he has many more years as a Rizian left ahead of him."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""You survived that crucible unscath..."
entries.dialogueText: "You survived that crucible unscathed. I hope my cousin does too."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""The war will go on for as long as..."
entries.dialogueText: "The war will go on for as long as it has to, Leona. I'm proud that our family is doing its part against the Palesian menace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am grateful for your assistance,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am grateful for your assistance, Manus. And I hope you will still offer it even if my new heir jeopardizes your status as Crown Prince Consort."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A bead of sweat appeared on his bro..."
entries.dialogueText: A bead of sweat appeared on his brow.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will. After we cleanse the king..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will. After we cleanse the kingdom of sinners and blasphemers, that is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""More religion does not automatical..."
entries.dialogueText: "More religion does not automatically lead to more oppression. I expect this transition to bring a new age of enlightenment to our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Princess Vina and I will aid you n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Princess Vina and I will aid you no matter what, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He blanched."
entries.dialogueText: He blanched.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I'm excited for what that might lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm excited for what that might look like."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am glad that you support my deci..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am glad that you support my decision. I'd hate to think you and Her Highness are only biding your time until I die and you undo everything I've built."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A bead of sweat appeared on his bro..."
entries.dialogueText: A bead of sweat appeared on his brow.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""No, Your Majesty. Never.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, Your Majesty. Never."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""All is well, Your Majesty. I canno..."
entries.dialogueText: "All is well, Your Majesty. I cannot thank you enough for restoring my prior title."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The decision to install a council..."
entries.dialogueText: "The decision to install a council has proven rather controversial."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The elected leadership has become..."
entries.dialogueText: "The elected leadership has become emboldened. They are already devising frameworks in order to sidestep royal decrees they do not agree with."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""It has been a challenge, but one t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has been a challenge, but one that House Sazon has gladly risen to."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica nodded her assent."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica nodded her assent.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""But the local leadership is optimi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the local leadership is optimistic. Now that it's been freed from Wehlen's tyranny, Zille will flourish once more."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""We continue to see clashes between..."
entries.dialogueText: "We continue to see clashes between Rizian loyalists and Wehzeks who believe the referendum results were illegitimate."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""We continue to see protests by Smo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We continue to see protests by Smolak loyalists who believe the referendum results were illegitimate."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""We're still seeing clashes between..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're still seeing clashes between Rizian and Wehzek loyalists, even with the AN forces around to keep the peace."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""We're still seeing clashes between..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're still seeing clashes between monarchists and Smolak loyalists, even with the AN forces around to keep the peace."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Su Omina's presence in the region..."
entries.dialogueText: "Su Omina's presence in the region is a source of tension, to say the least..."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Su Omina's presence in the region..."
entries.dialogueText: "Su Omina's presence in the region is a source of tension, to say the least..."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""A small number of Smolak loyalists..."
entries.dialogueText: "A small number of Smolak loyalists still refuse to accept the results of the referendum."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""A small number of Wehzek loyalists..."
entries.dialogueText: "A small number of Wehzek loyalists still refuse to accept the results of the referendum."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""A small number of Smolak loyalists..."
entries.dialogueText: "A small number of Smolak loyalists still refuse to acknowledge the new government."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""A small number of Wehzek loyalists..."
entries.dialogueText: "A small number of Wehzek loyalists still refuse to acknowledge the new government."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""We are working to reunite Wehzek f..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are working to reunite Wehzek families that have been split across the border."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""We are working to reunite Wehzek f..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are working to reunite Wehzek families that have been split across the border."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""But the local leadership is optimi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the local leadership is optimistic. Especially after the Intermerkopum pact brought Wehlen and Rizia closer together."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""But the local leadership is optimi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the local leadership is optimistic. Especially after the Intermerkopum pact brought Wehlen and Rizia closer together."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona forced a smile. She glanced a..."
entries.dialogueText: Leona forced a smile. She glanced across the room at Rico.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""There's nothing to report, really...."
entries.dialogueText: "There's nothing to report, really. The people remain grateful that Duke Ricardus has restored much-needed law and order."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""By 'cleanse' I'll assume you are r..."
entries.dialogueText: "By 'cleanse' I'll assume you are referring to education and open dialogue."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Under the Crown's oversight, law a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Under the Crown's oversight, law and order have been restored to the city."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How is everything in Brenas, gener..."
entries.dialogueText: "How is everything in Brenas, generally?"

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""With all of Brenas now united unde..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all of Brenas now united under the Sazon banner, our house is finally gaining the respectability it lacked for so long."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""It has been an interesting experim..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has been an interesting experiment, Your Majesty, but I do worry that our house is being undermined."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""It has been an interesting experim..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has been an interesting experiment, Your Majesty, but I do worry that our house is being undermined."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona forced a smile. She glanced a..."
entries.dialogueText: Leona forced a smile. She glanced across the room at Rico.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Duke Ricardus is trying his best,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Ricardus is trying his best, despite pushback from the locals. There's really no appeasing some people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona forced a smile."
entries.dialogueText: Leona forced a smile.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Of course, the students at the uni..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, the students at the university don't see it that way. But there's no appeasing some people."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I've faced pushback from Brenas co..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've faced pushback from Brenas councilors and the students at the university. But there's really no appeasing some people."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I've faced pushback from the stude..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've faced pushback from the students at the university. But there's really no appeasing some people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Zille has always held a special pl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille has always held a special place in my heart. I trust your family to take good care of it."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""But the local leadership is optimi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the local leadership is optimistic. Now that it's been freed from Wehlen's tyranny, Zille will flourish once more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Any citizen of Zille who disagrees..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any citizen of Zille who disagrees with Rizian rule must face appropriate punishment. You will see to that, won't you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand it's not an easy tran..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand it's not an easy transition. We must extend a helping hand to these new Rizians, even those who still consider themselves Wehzek."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""These rebels you speak of should b..."
entries.dialogueText: "These rebels you speak of should be closely monitored. The slightest hint of instability in the region will cause it to slip from our grasp once more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Brilliant. I hope you're preparing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Brilliant. I hope you're preparing a royal residence so I'll have somewhere to stay when I visit."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""You and the Queen Consort are welc..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and the Queen Consort are welcome anytime."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""We will make sure of it. You are w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will make sure of it. You are welcome anytime."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I couldn't agree more.""
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't agree more."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I can personally guarantee that th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can personally guarantee that they will not be a problem."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""It will be as if the past 30 years..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will be as if the past 30 years never even happened."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""We'll strengthen our oversight, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll strengthen our oversight, Your Majesty. Whatever it takes."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""It is not every day we have an aud..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not every day we have an audience with His Majesty. We might as well be honest."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus subtly shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: Manus subtly shook his head.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Just splendid, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just splendid, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""For the first time in a long time,..."
entries.dialogueText: "For the first time in a long time, our province feels seen and heard by the Crown."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The hydroelectric dam? An incredib..."
entries.dialogueText: "The hydroelectric dam? An incredible feat of engineering."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The expanded Grandsanctuary was wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The expanded Grandsanctuary was worth every second of labor that went into it. Tourists come to see it from far and wide -- not only Dastnurist ones, either."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The expansion of the Sallabes Gran..."
entries.dialogueText: "The expansion of the Sallabes Grandsanctuary has had its share of delays, as you know, but I'm sure it will be worth it in the end."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She frowned briefly."
entries.dialogueText: She frowned briefly.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""And of course, the entire province..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, the entire province rejoiced at the marriage between my son and Princess Vina."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not lie to me, Countess. How is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not lie to me, Countess. How is everything, really?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. As the highest-ranking Sazon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. As the highest-ranking Sazon in the region, it's your responsibility to keep your relatives in line."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If there are any problems you'd li..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there are any problems you'd like to bring up with your King, now is the time."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Yes. You're right as usual, Angeli..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. You're right as usual, Angelica."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I will.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She raised her eyes to meet mine."
entries.dialogueText: She raised her eyes to meet mine.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Your Majesty, House Sazon is still..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, House Sazon is still struggling from a lack of proper leadership."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Perhaps Manus will reclaim the tit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps Manus will reclaim the title of Duke when he returns from war. But for now, we are seeing infighting -- and, dare I say it, faltering allegiance to the Crown."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Without an heir like Manus to unit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Without an heir like Manus to unite behind, there has been infighting -- and dare I say it, faltering allegiance to the Crown."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""With Manus in opposition to your p..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Manus in opposition to your policies, there has been infighting -- and dare I say it, faltering allegiance to the Crown."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Your Majesty, I am saddened to rep..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I am saddened to report that House Sazon's allegiance to the Crown has begun to falter once more."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Not our own allegiance, of course...."
entries.dialogueText: "Not our own allegiance, of course. But yes."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""His Majesty was implying nothing...."
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty was implying nothing. We can all agree that my father should never have done what he did."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona readjusted one of her hairpin..."
entries.dialogueText: Leona readjusted one of her hairpins.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I do tire of this political talk...."
entries.dialogueText: "I do tire of this political talk. Shall we change the subject?"

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Ha! Good luck with that, son.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ha! Good luck with that, son."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked askance at him."
entries.dialogueText: She looked askance at him.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Or maybe the next Lucas Sazon is a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or maybe the next Lucas Sazon is already here."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The stress of the Pales conflict...""
entries.dialogueText: "The stress of the Pales conflict..."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""With Manus in the capital most of..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Manus in the capital most of the time, Brenas is succumbing to infighting -- and, dare I say it, faltering allegiance to the Crown."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""It was the very least we could do.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was the very least we could do."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I never would have imagined Brenas..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never would have imagined Brenas as a center of industry, but the growth our industrial production has brought to the economy has been stunning."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""And of course, the entire province..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, the entire province rejoiced at the marriage between Manus and Princess Vina."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The lingering presence of Su Omina..."
entries.dialogueText: "The lingering presence of Su Omina..."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""And now the news that Manus might..."
entries.dialogueText: "And now the news that Manus might lose his claim to the throne..."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""It's all too much for a Countess s..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's all too much for a Countess such as myself to manage on my own."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""There is but one House Sazon membe..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is but one House Sazon member who could bring order back to Brenas. But she remains on Caleqabiz."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The stress of the Pales conflict...""
entries.dialogueText: "The stress of the Pales conflict..."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The lingering presence of Su Omina..."
entries.dialogueText: "The lingering presence of Su Omina..."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""And now the news that Manus might..."
entries.dialogueText: "And now the news that Manus might lose his claim to the throne..."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""It is a lot for our house to manag..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a lot for our house to manage."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Especially after the disappointmen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially after the disappointment of losing Zille."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica smiled triumphantly."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica smiled triumphantly.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Thank you, Your Majesty. That's al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty. That's all we ever wanted."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Angelica, the traitor? Never. She..."
entries.dialogueText: "Angelica, the traitor? Never. She will die on that island."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Three decades has been long enough..."
entries.dialogueText: "Three decades has been long enough. Tell Angelica Sazon that her banishment is over."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How can you guarantee that she wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "How can you guarantee that she will do as you claim? That she doesn't still resent the Crown for punishing her?"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""We have spoken many times, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have spoken many times, Your Majesty. Set her free, and I guarantee she will be a loyal ally."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's been over 30 years. Does Bren..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's been over 30 years. Does Brenas even remember her?"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Even from exile, she commands the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even from exile, she commands the hearts of our province."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Do you mean that?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you mean that?"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""She is no traitor, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "She is no traitor, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Remember, she was the one who hand..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember, she was the one who handed in Lucas Sazon to your father. Her own husband!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She was saving her own skin. That..."
entries.dialogueText: "She was saving her own skin. That hardly counts as loyalty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It does take courage to commit suc..."
entries.dialogueText: "It does take courage to commit such an act. Especially as a young woman."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All that says to me is that she is..."
entries.dialogueText: "All that says to me is that she is capable of lying and treachery, even against those she loves."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Countess put a hand to her hear..."
entries.dialogueText: The Countess put a hand to her heart in astonishment.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""First Zille, now this... the rift..."
entries.dialogueText: "First Zille, now this... the rift between our houses truly has begun to heal."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The rift between our houses truly..."
entries.dialogueText: "The rift between our houses truly has begun to heal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Leona nodded.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""She was risking her own life. She..."
entries.dialogueText: "She was risking her own life. She didn't know what punishment awaited her."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""She did it for the sake of her chi..."
entries.dialogueText: "She did it for the sake of her child. And for the sake of her kingdom."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""She realized that a movement that..."
entries.dialogueText: "She realized that a movement that would ask her to risk the life of her child was not one worth fighting for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am moved by your love for your c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am moved by your love for your cousin. If you truly do vouch for her loyalty, I will end her exile."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I see...""
entries.dialogueText: "I see..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am not convinced. Angelica will..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not convinced. Angelica will remain in Caleqabiz."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Her sacrifice on behalf of the Cro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Her sacrifice on behalf of the Crown was a memorable act indeed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her shoulders fell."
entries.dialogueText: Her shoulders fell.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If she could turn on her husband l..."
entries.dialogueText: "If she could turn on her husband like that, she could turn on her King. She cannot be trusted."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I never would have expected this,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never would have expected this, Your Majesty. Please accept my gratitude."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""And of course, we are still indebt..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, we are still indebted to you for arranging my pardon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I trust you, Leona. If you can lea..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust you, Leona. If you can lead Sallabes, you can bring the other Sazons back to House Toras' side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell your peers in Brenas that if..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell your peers in Brenas that if any of them dare to speak out against me, they will face the guillotine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""However, your fellow Sazons needn'..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, your fellow Sazons needn't worry about Manus losing his claim to the throne. Vina will remain first in line to succeed me, no matter what."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""That's truly incredible to hear. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's truly incredible to hear. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and Manus broke into relieved s..."
entries.dialogueText: She and Manus broke into relieved smiles.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is my pleasure to make your fam..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is my pleasure to make your family whole once again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When she returns, her first duty s..."
entries.dialogueText: "When she returns, her first duty shall be punishing all those members of your house who dared to speak against me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And Manus, you needn't worry about..."
entries.dialogueText: "And Manus, you needn't worry about losing your claim to the throne. Vina will remain first in line to succeed me, no matter what."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sure Hegel was getting sick of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure Hegel was getting sick of a disgraced Rizian noble squatting on his island, anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sure Alvarez was getting sick..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure Alvarez was getting sick of a disgraced Rizian noble squatting on his island, anyway."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Angelica did write that the newcom..."
entries.dialogueText: "Angelica did write that the newcomers to the island were giving her angry looks."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus shook my hand enthusiasticall..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus shook my hand enthusiastically.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Yes... I imagine she'll enjoy that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... I imagine she'll enjoy that."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""We will serve you with honor. Just..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will serve you with honor. Just as we did before 1926."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's nothing personal, Countess. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's nothing personal, Countess. But I can't just go around pardoning everyone for their crimes."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""But your decree...""
entries.dialogueText: "But your decree..."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Never mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I... I will try.""
entries.dialogueText: "I... I will try."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Zille has yet to recover from the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille has yet to recover from the effects of the Wehlen occupation. You want to destabilize it further?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You think adding several million W..."
entries.dialogueText: "You think adding several million Wehzeks to your population will bring order to Brenas? I've got news for you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why not? That was only a transitor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why not? That was only a transitory measure anyway. Zille is yours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see.  You never forgave my famil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see.  You never forgave my family for taking Zille away from you."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""We would not be destabilizing the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We would not be destabilizing the province. We would be uniting it under its former banner."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Not Wehzeks any longer, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not Wehzeks any longer, Your Majesty. Rizians."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes gleamed bright."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes gleamed bright.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Thank you, Your Majesty. I and my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I and my house are forever in your debt."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Zille was taken from all of Brenas..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille was taken from all of Brenas, even from those who didn't participate in the uprising."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""You showed great faith in House Sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "You showed great faith in House Sazon by returning Iza to us. With Zille, all of Brenas will finally be whole again."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""We Sazons still have the loss of I..."
entries.dialogueText: "We Sazons still have the loss of Iza to remind us of the folly of 1926. With Zille, our province will be that much closer to being whole again."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""On the other hand, if you were to..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, if you were to reconsider your decision to centralize the region..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If that is what your house truly w..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that is what your house truly wants, then I will grant your request. I will reverse my decision and arrange for the integration of Zille into Brenas."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That was not the outcome any of us..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was not the outcome any of us wanted. I sympathize with your house, but there is nothing I can do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you want my royal advice? Get o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you want my royal advice? Get over it. Move on. The rest of us have."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am surprised that House Sazon's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am surprised that House Sazon's loyalty is so conditional, Angelica. Especially after the events of the 1920s."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Had it been up to me, Zille would..."
entries.dialogueText: "Had it been up to me, Zille would have been yours again by now."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I am surprised as well, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am surprised as well, Your Majesty. I have told the others their concerns are unfounded."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes narrowed."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes narrowed.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""We are trying.""
entries.dialogueText: "We are trying."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Yes, I know. None of us could have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I know. None of us could have anticipated Wiktor Smolak's actions."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""But sacrificing Zille to regain Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "But sacrificing Zille to regain Pales? It sends a rather strong message to those of us in Brenas."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""A joy undimmed by the news of your..."
entries.dialogueText: "A joy undimmed by the news of your second heir. Congratulations on that, by the way."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""A joy undimmed by the news of a se..."
entries.dialogueText: "A joy undimmed by the news of a second heir to the throne. Congratulations on that, by the way, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And Manus, you needn't worry about..."
entries.dialogueText: "And Manus, you needn't worry about losing your claim to the throne. Vina will remain first in line to succeed me, no matter what."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus shook my hand enthusiasticall..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus shook my hand enthusiastically.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand your frustrations, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your frustrations, but I vow that your patience will be rewarded one day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am warning you. Not another word..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am warning you. Not another word, or you'll be sent back to Caleqabiz."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Here is what I can offer. Your son..."
entries.dialogueText: "Here is what I can offer. Your son and my daughter will succeed me as monarchs of Rizia. No matter what."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""That would be wonderful news, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "That would be wonderful news, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your son and my daughter are set t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your son and my daughter are set to succeed me after I die. Isn't that enough consolation for your house?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica bowed her head."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica bowed her head.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""It should be.""
entries.dialogueText: "It should be."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica bowed her head."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica bowed her head.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I am sorry. Let's not dwell on thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry. Let's not dwell on this any longer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am looking out for the kingdom a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am looking out for the kingdom as a whole, not only your house. I sincerely believe that Zille's reintegration will be more successful if it is overseen by the central government."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica bowed her head."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica bowed her head.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Understood. I will question you no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Understood. I will question you no further."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""As long as they keep the throne th..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as they keep the throne they are given."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Of course we will, Mother.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course we will, Mother."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""As long as they keep the throne th..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as they keep the throne they are given."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We will, Mother. And thank you, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will, Mother. And thank you, Your Majesty. Vina will be overjoyed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I expect to hear only words of gra..."
entries.dialogueText: "I expect to hear only words of gratitude from House Sazon from now on. No complaints."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Yes -- yes, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes -- yes, of course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your house has a long, proud histo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your house has a long, proud history of supporting the Crown. We should not let the last 30 years get in the way of that."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""No, indeed not.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, indeed not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All the administrative difficultie..."
entries.dialogueText: "All the administrative difficulties and culture clashes -- those are yours to deal with now."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""And we will relish the challenge.""
entries.dialogueText: "And we will relish the challenge."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The only thing that would make our..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only thing that would make our house happier is... well, never mind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's not spoil this moment with m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not spoil this moment with more tedious requests. It's been a pleasure talking to you, Leona."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Out with it. What do you want?""
entries.dialogueText: "Out with it. What do you want?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Leona. It would be my pleasure to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Leona. It would be my pleasure to reward House Sazon for the loyalty you have shown me these past years."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Yes. To you as well.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. To you as well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She snuck a glance at Manus."
entries.dialogueText: She snuck a glance at Manus.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I will only ask this once more, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will only ask this once more, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Angelica Sazon still languishes in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Angelica Sazon still languishes in exile on Caleqabiz. Could you not imagine setting her free to walk on her home soil?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What makes you think she even want..."
entries.dialogueText: "What makes you think she even wants to return? That she doesn't still resent the Crown for punishing her?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I never would have expected this,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never would have expected this, Your Majesty. Your mercy is... surprising."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""As I said, I will not trouble you..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I said, I will not trouble you with this any further. You've done enough for the Sazons."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our houses have had a long and har..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our houses have had a long and harmonious history together. We shouldn't let the last 30 years spoil everything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am glad your house remembers its..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am glad your house remembers its place. We wouldn't have to send you back to Caleqabiz, would we?"

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""No, indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, indeed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your congratulations are most acce..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your congratulations are most accepted. Lucita and I are very happy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I allowed Vina and Manus to marry..."
entries.dialogueText: "I allowed Vina and Manus to marry for a reason. My new heir will not be an obstacle between them and the Rizian throne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She beamed with delight, then glanc..."
entries.dialogueText: She beamed with delight, then glanced suspiciously at Manus.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Is that so?!""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that so?!"

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""This is all assuming that the Rizi..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is all assuming that the Rizian throne is something my son wants."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I do, Mother. And Vina will be ove..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do, Mother. And Vina will be overjoyed."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The King of Rizia bringing new lif..."
entries.dialogueText: "The King of Rizia bringing new life into the world is indeed something to celebrate."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona smiled at me warmly, ignoring..."
entries.dialogueText: Leona smiled at me warmly, ignoring the looks of disappointment from Angelica and Manus.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Confidentially, I hope it's a girl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Confidentially, I hope it's a girl. I wouldn't want anything to get in the way of Vina and Manus' inheritance."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Nor would we, Your Majesty. But su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nor would we, Your Majesty. But such things are up to the universe, not men."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""On the other hand, Rizia's success..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, Rizia's succession laws are man-made. With the emphasis on 'man'."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus kept his mouth shut."
entries.dialogueText: Manus kept his mouth shut.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She laughed nervously."
entries.dialogueText: She laughed nervously.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""No, never.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, never."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You and I are united by a common g..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and I are united by a common goal, Angelica. We both want grandchildren."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus cleared his throat nervously."
entries.dialogueText: Manus cleared his throat nervously.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Eventually, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Eventually, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's only a pity it didn't work ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's only a pity it didn't work out between my daughter and your son."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus cleared his throat nervously."
entries.dialogueText: Manus cleared his throat nervously.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""No hard feelings, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "No hard feelings, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""You never know. It still might.""
entries.dialogueText: "You never know. It still might."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""That was hardly your fault, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was hardly your fault, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Those terrible Palesians. I hope s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Those terrible Palesians. I hope she makes it home soon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona brought a handkerchief to her..."
entries.dialogueText: Leona brought a handkerchief to her eye.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Those boys on the front lines... T..."
entries.dialogueText: "Those boys on the front lines... Truly tragic."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""To fight for Rizia the way he did..."
entries.dialogueText: "To fight for Rizia the way he did took real courage. His father never would have done the same."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""He surprised us all in the end, di..."
entries.dialogueText: "He surprised us all in the end, didn't he?"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""My own son's about to enter univer..."
entries.dialogueText: "My own son's about to enter university. To think that could have been him..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A Sazon's been dodging the draft?..."
entries.dialogueText: "A Sazon's been dodging the draft? You need to get him into uniform immediately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's good that he's out of harm's..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's good that he's out of harm's way. Rizia's going to need bright young minds when the war is over."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My daughter is still missing. This..."
entries.dialogueText: "My daughter is still missing. This conflict has brought death and destruction into all of our lives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry, Countess. We will win..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry, Countess. We will win before your son has to fight."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her face went white."
entries.dialogueText: Her face went white.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I'll speak to him when I get home,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll speak to him when I get home, Your Majesty. It may be difficult with classes in full swing."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""He's the brightest of them all, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's the brightest of them all, Your Majesty. Always eager to do his part."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""May it all be worth it in the end.""
entries.dialogueText: "May it all be worth it in the end."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I hope so. We're all supporting th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope so. We're all supporting the war from afar."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As much as I'd love to keep talkin..."
entries.dialogueText: "As much as I'd love to keep talking to you, I have other guests to entertain."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Naturally. I'm sure the other hous..."
entries.dialogueText: "Naturally. I'm sure the other houses are dying to speak with you as well."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Come to Brenas anytime, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come to Brenas anytime, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Yes. We'll speak soon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. We'll speak soon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He glanced nervously at his mother...."
entries.dialogueText: He glanced nervously at his mother. I wondered how much she suspected.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I extricated myself from House S..."
entries.dialogueText: As I extricated myself from House Sazon, I looked around at the remaining guests.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She's even happier that House Sazo..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's even happier that House Sazon came to pay its respects."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""May our cooperation now herald a l..."
entries.dialogueText: "May our cooperation now herald a lasting peace in the years to come."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""They will all come around. What's..."
entries.dialogueText: "They will all come around. What's the alternative?"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Let's hope it doesn't come to that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hope it doesn't come to that."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I won't keep you any longer. But w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't keep you any longer. But we will update you on our progress against the rebellion."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Come to Brenas anytime, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come to Brenas anytime, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Yes... I hope this was the right d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... I hope this was the right decision."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I extricated myself from House S..."
entries.dialogueText: As I extricated myself from House Sazon, I looked around at the remaining guests.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona looked me in the eye as she b..."
entries.dialogueText: Leona looked me in the eye as she bowed.
